title: Sandwich
desc: Sher Singh has two wives, Nisha and Sweety, and juggles his time between them. However, when his two wives cross paths, his troubles increase manifold leading to hilarious situations.

title: Aaj Ka Arjun
desc: A ruthless landlord exiles Bheema due to his rebellion against him. However, when his nephew is abducted, Bheema sets out to gain the support of the villagers and rescue the boy.

title: Hamara Khandan
desc: Vishal, who hails from a wealthy Hindu family, falls in love with Ruby, a poor Catholic girl. While her father approves of the marriage, his father does his best to stop them from marrying.

title: Keemat: They Are Back
desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyaar Kiya
desc: Pooja divorces her husband for being unfaithful and gets a job as secretary to a film star. The two fall in love, before her ex-husband returns, and she finds herself confused between the two men.
